alert_name: Suspicious DNS Query to Newly Registered Domain
evidence: Host FIN-WKSTN-08 (10.40.7.155) resolved update-check.bad-actor.test 38 times in the last hour via DNS server 10.40.0.2.
The domain bad-actor.test was first observed 2 days ago and has no reputation in threat intel feeds.
Returned A record 203.0.113.77 has a low TTL of 60 seconds, consistent with fast-flux or dynamic infrastructure.
No corresponding business application is mapped to update-check.bad-actor.test in the asset inventory.
